svg.title: Place fields depend on sampling, journey, and context (synthetic schematic)
svg.desc: Three panels. A: one synthetic cell's trajectory and spikes, the time spent in each of 12 by 12 bins, and the resulting firing rate (spike count divided by time in bin); a top-right corner was never visited and its rate is undefined. B: two inbound W-track journeys, left to center and right to center, share the same center-arm segment in the same direction; heat strips show three cells firing differently on that segment depending on the journey. C: three cells' rate maps in two contexts, showing rate remapping (same field locations, changed rates) and global remapping (fields move independently, one disappears). Synthetic examples; not experimental data.
